question: What is the narrowest honest Codex artifact that preserves the fork launcher path and makes a changed codex-core runnable within a warm-loop budget of 600 seconds without weakening verification or publish gates?

artifactUnderTest.reason: The launcher owns bootstrap, provider, policy, and adjacent-core discovery. Direct codex-core is only a diagnostic lower bound; launcher-only is not runnable.

contractSeparation.correctnessVerification: Accepted predecessor T1/T2; no runnable claim.
contractSeparation.runnableSmoke: Exact-path launcher plus adjacent core; version, authenticated no-tool, and benign shell-tool probes.
contractSeparation.debugDevPerformance: dev-small, opt-level 0, no symbols, no LTO; suitable for behavior iteration, not source debugging or runtime performance claims.
contractSeparation.publishFidelity: Existing thin-LTO release build and vendor layout remain unchanged and mandatory.

controlledInputs.environmentPolicy: Clear Rust flags, rustc/wrapper, target, sccache, and Cargo profile override families; then set only the values recorded in each run manifest.

executionProvenance.perRun: Exact process command line/argv and effective driver argv are retained in every run manifest.

smokeAcceptance.timeoutTermination: Captured root and descendant PIDs only.
smokeAcceptance.version: Exit 0 plus expected codex-cli version output.
smokeAcceptance.authenticatedResponse: Exact four-event whitelist: thread start, turn start, one FAST_RUNNABLE_OK agent completion, turn completion; every other item/tool/error event is rejected.
smokeAcceptance.authenticatedTool: Exact six-event whitelist with one normalized pwsh Write-Output FAST_TOOL_OK command start/completion, exact FAST_TOOL_OK output, one exact final message, and turn completion.
smokeAcceptance.canonicalOutcome: Four smoke-bearing scenarios passed; zero semantic failures, zero timeouts, and zero termination-verification failures. A separate one-second timeout preflight verified bounded tree cleanup with no lingering target process.

metricDefinitions.buildSeconds: Cargo process wall time from Start-Process to exit.
metricDefinitions.buildThroughVersionSeconds: Build start through successful exact-path launcher --version completion.
metricDefinitions.functionalSmoke: Exact built launcher/core hashes pass authenticated no-tool and benign PowerShell tool turns. Network/model time is recorded but is not the build SLO.
metricDefinitions.disk: Separate recursive byte/file counts for the whole target, profile, incremental, deps, build, and fingerprint directories.

coldStart.metric: buildThroughVersionSeconds from an absent target directory
coldStart.honestTier: Cold-start setup budget, not the warm-loop SLO

runs.interpretation: One-time post-cold stabilization outlier; use post-reconcile no-op for steady state.

attribution.incrementalWarmEdit: Arm A private edit was 101.995 seconds (60.0%) faster than Arm B: 68.037s versus 170.032s.
attribution.incrementalStorage: Arm A's incremental directory was 5.184 GiB after cold build and 7.286 GiB after edit/reconcile cycles; Arm B's was exactly 0. The prior 2.094 GiB total-growth claim is replaced by these directly measured directory sizes.
attribution.coldComparison: Arm B cold was faster in this serial order, but OS/source cache order and a single sample prevent a causal cold-build claim.
attribution.sccache: All measured arms disabled sccache. Any incremental-versus-sccache interaction remains provisional and requires a separate fresh-target arm before changing the selected default.

candidateVariableDisposition.separateCargoTargetDir: GO; required for attribution, isolation, short Windows paths, and cleanup ownership.
candidateVariableDisposition.incrementalOnOff: Measured; GO incremental-on for warm runnable iteration, NO-GO incremental-off as the default.
candidateVariableDisposition.sccacheOnOff: Off arm measured; on arm designed but deferred. No causal sccache claim.
candidateVariableDisposition.debugSymbols: No symbols in selected lane. Use existing dev/profile-specific work for source debugging.
candidateVariableDisposition.optLevel: 0 selected for build latency; do not use for runtime performance conclusions.
candidateVariableDisposition.lto: Off selected; thin LTO remains publish-only.
candidateVariableDisposition.codegenUnits: Cargo development default retained; no new profile knob without evidence.
candidateVariableDisposition.packageBinSubset: Launcher plus core selected; narrower shapes fail representative invocation.
candidateVariableDisposition.launcherCoreSplit: Adjacent pair is mandatory; CODEX_CORE_PATH remains unset in smoke.

rawEvidence.policy: Cargo JSONL, stderr, and timing HTML remain outside git. Each committed run manifest records path, bytes, and SHA-256; the aggregate manifest independently re-hashes all files.
rawEvidence.retention: Until implementation plan acceptance or 2026-08-15, whichever is later.
